# Tijani Shabazz — Full Portfolio Context

## Professional profile
Tijani Shabazz is a Senior Full-Stack & AI Software Engineer based in Fort Lauderdale, Florida. The supplied resume states 11+ years of experience building and evolving production software across web, mobile, enterprise, and AI-powered products. His work combines end-to-end application engineering with backend architecture, API and systems integration, data-intensive workflows, cloud delivery, and production reliability.

## Professional summary
Tijani develops web platforms with C#/.NET, Python, TypeScript, React, and SQL; cross-platform mobile applications with React Native and Flutter; and AI-enabled systems using LLMs, RAG, AI agents, MCP tools, and retrieval workflows. Project experience spans healthcare, logistics, financial integrations, marketplaces, real estate, and enterprise IT.

## Project case studies

### 1. Anchord AI — Entity Resolution & Agent Integration
Product context: an entity-resolution platform connecting AI agents to business data and helping determine whether records from different sources represent the same real-world entity.
Tijani's documented role: integrated agent workflows with 11 MCP tools, REST APIs, and webhooks; implemented multi-signal, rules-based scoring; added evidence-backed review for ambiguous matches; established canonical entity IDs and resolve-before-write flows.
Engineering focus: candidate scoring, match review, canonical identity, tool integration, and safe write sequencing.
Public link: https://www.anchord.ai/product

### 2. Correlate Health / LooPT — Clinical Trial Matching
Product context: a healthcare platform evaluating structured EHR data and clinical notes against clinical-trial eligibility criteria.
Tijani's documented role: worked on healthcare workflows, data validation, complex eligibility rules, API integration, auditability, and human review.
Engineering focus: structured and narrative clinical information, eligibility logic, validation, audit trail, and review workflows.
Public link: https://correlatehealth.com/

### 3. Freight SaaS — QuickBooks Online Integration
Product context: integration between freight operations and QuickBooks Online.
Tijani's documented role: built OAuth, token refresh, webhook, idempotent synchronization, and reconciliation workflows.
Operational scale: approximately 65 brokerages, 52,000 loads per month, and 90,000 documents per month.
Engineering focus: external accounting API lifecycle, repeated event handling, reliable synchronization, and reconciliation.

### 4. .NET 8 & Azure OpenAI Data Processing
Product context: worker-service and data-processing workflows integrating Azure OpenAI with a SQL-backed application.
Tijani's documented role: developed worker-service and data-processing workflows using ASP.NET Core, EF Core, SQL Server, and Azure OpenAI.
Operational scale: approximately 2,400 records per day against a historical dataset of around 1.6 million records.
Engineering focus: .NET worker services, relational persistence, and AI service integration.

### 5. CrushBank Orchestrate IT — Enterprise AI
Product context: enterprise AI platform using IBM watsonx, connected information sources, grounded search and answers, service-ticket classification, and operational workflow automation.
Tijani's documented role: contributed to enterprise AI integrations involving connected information sources, grounded search/answers, ticket classification, and workflow automation.
Public link: https://www.crushbank.com/orchestrate-it/

### 6. OurBlackGuide — React Native Marketplace
Product context: community discovery application for local businesses, professional services, entrepreneurs, events, career resources, and marketplace listings.
Tijani's documented role: contributed to React Native architecture and reusable iOS/Android components using TypeScript, React Navigation, and TanStack Query; integrated authentication and APIs; worked on directory search, category/location filters, pagination, business profiles, image uploads, deep links, performance, and production releases.

### 7. Parente AI — Cross-Platform Health Application
